items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got in touch with Thad Cochran, who is a Senator from Mississippi, I think, and she complained to him about something

ctx.x: It’s September 14, 2012. Ted Panken here, and this is the second day of a two-day oral history interview with Mose Allison, Amy Allison, and Audre Allison, who was here yesterday. Before we pick up the thread and take this from 1960 to the present, more or less, let’s pick up on a few other topics we were discussing yesterday. One, which Audre was suggesting, was to say a bit more about Mose’s mother, Maxine Allison. She was a teacher. I read about how she came to Tippo, on the slightly false pretenses of a…
I got in touch with Thad Cochran, who is a Senator from Mississippi, I think, and she complained to him about something...I don’t know...
Are you talking about when she was playing bridge?
